summary: The live-refreshed Nets dossiers hold up on history, dates and league facts. Five errors were fixed in place: the Carnival insight title (music), the 2020 census count (culture), the franchise's New Jersey Americans start (hoops), the New York Nets era years (uniform) and the Antic end point (food). The weak spots are store doors in the knowledge-mode retail-landscape file (Kith, Dr. Jays, Buffalo Exchange, Brooklyn Industries), the Brooklyn Brigade, and the single-source Oct 21 home opener the brief launches on. The shared web-search budget was already spent when this run started, so no new live searches were possible. Verdicts rest on the dossiers' own sources and the public record. The strategy brief overstates the Knicks' opening-night role.
